summary: Quetta Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026 disclosing a $60,000 extension payment deposited August 10, 2026 into its trust account for the benefit of public stockholders, extending the deadline to consummate its initial business combination by one month from September 10, 2026 to October 10, 2026. The registrant, a Nasdaq-listed blank-check company trading as QETAU/QETA/QETAR, remains in the pre-deal stage with no target or business combination agreement identified. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, premium, or close date was stated. The extension payment came from sponsor or affiliate funds, not public shareholders, and is a single-month reprieve rather than a full extension. Risk-arb angle: watch for subsequent monthly extensions, trust depletion math, redemption levels at any extension vote, and any definitive merger announcement before October 10, 2026, as a failure to close triggers liquidation and loss of sponsor promote.
